# Rentastic

> Rentastic is accounting and property management software purpose-built for real estate investors to track expenses, analyze profits, and simplify tax reporting.

Rentastic provides an integrated platform for rental property accounting, expense tracking, and financial analysis. The software helps real estate investors manage multiple properties, automate tax reporting, and make data-driven investment decisions through features like receipt scanning, profit/loss analysis, and deal evaluation tools.

## Key Topics

- Rental Accounting
- Property Management
- Real Estate Investors
- Expense Tracking
- Tax Reporting
- Profit & Loss Analysis
- Deal Analyzer
- Bank Account Linking
- Receipt Scanning
- Tenant Management
- 1031 Exchange
- Subscription Plans
- Getting Started
- QuickBooks Integration
